name: btl-label-autopilot
description: Buys and prints shipping labels by itself when you make a sale (Etsy, eBay, Shopify and more via Shippo), on a BTL Print Bridge.

SHIPPO_API_KEY.description: **Replace the example** with your **live** Shippo API token. In Shippo, open the API page (Settings → API, or the Shippo developer portal) and make a **Live** token. It starts with `shippo_live_`. Labels are charged to your Shippo account.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: **Replace the example** with your own password for the settings page (8+ characters). You'll type it when you open the page (any username works).

LABELS.description: Storage for your settings and the print queue. Leave as is.
